text: 7月23日消息，证监会日前下发关于同意苏州信诺维医药科技股份有限公司首次公开发行股票注册的批复，同意该公司首次公开发行股票并在科创板上市的注册申请。
text_en: July 23 news - The China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) recently issued approval for Suzhou Sinovent Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd.'s initial public offering registration, agreeing to its registration application for an IPO on the STAR Market.
